reason: A is the more specific and falsifiable proposal because it defines an alloy, Ti content, testing regime, reference composition, and measurable trade-off. Its central rationale is nevertheless flawed—Ti has lower VEC than NbMoTaWV and therefore cannot increase the alloy VEC as claimed, while the cited evidence does not support Ti-induced cohesion or ordering suppression—whereas B is too composition- and temperature-unspecified to establish that coherent precipitates can form.
